draw_agent_on_map: draw a rotated and resized agent sprite onto a top-down map image at given coordinates
generate_pointnav_birdseye_view: generate a birdseye view image showing agent position relative to a navigation goal with colored distance bands
convert_realworld_to_grid_coords: convert real-world x,y coordinates to grid indices using a simulator pathfinder and map resolution
get_topdown_occupancy_map: get a top-down occupancy map from a habitat simulator pathfinder with optional border drawing
colorize_and_render_topdown_map: colorize a top-down map with fog of war masking, draw the agent, and resize to a target height
